can_answer: partly: the file can compare the number of people injured per reported crash across clock-time groups, a measure of recorded injury burden among crashes, but it has no travel-exposure denominator and cannot establish whether a traveler is more likely to be injured at night.
metric: Mean recorded persons injured per police-reported crash, grouped into day (06:00-19:59), night (20:00-23:59 and 01:00-05:59), and records stamped exactly 00:00:00 (shown separately as possible default-time records).
denominator: The number of included crash rows with a nonmissing number_of_persons_injured value in each group; this is injuries per crash, not injuries per person-trip, mile, or hour of travel.
population: One row per police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crash with a nonmissing DATE crash_date, TIME crash_time, and number_of_persons_injured, in complete calendar years represented in the file.
filters: Keep rows with a valid DATE crash_date and TIME crash_time
Keep records stamped 00:00:00 but show them in a separate group rather than assigning them to night
years: Complete-boundary years 2013-2025, determined by observed minimum and maximum crash dates within each year.
grouping: Day (06:00-19:59), night excluding exactly 00:00 (20:00-23:59 and 01:00-05:59), and the separate recorded-00:00:00 group.
data_check_and_decisions: The complete-boundary years contain 2,132,218 dated rows, all with nonmissing times; date coverage is partial in 2012 (July 1-December 31) and 2026 (January 1-June 11), so those 136,969 rows are excluded. No crash dates or times are NULL, and DATE/TIME types cannot hold blank strings, unknown words, or impossible calendar/time values. Exactly 23,787 complete-year rows (1.1158%) are stamped 00:00:00, with a pronounced pileup beginning in 2016; keep those rows as their own displayed group because the time may be a default. The persons-injured field is missing for 18 of 2,132,218 dated rows in 2013-2025; exclude those rows from the mean because the outcome is unavailable. The full-boundary check is based on first/last observed dates and cannot verify reporting completeness on every intervening day.
limitations: This is mean recorded injuries among reported crashes, not an injury risk per traveler or travel exposure. The file has no traffic-volume or exposure measure. The exact-00:00 pileup may reflect default times; it is displayed separately. Eighteen crashes with missing injury counts are excluded. Only complete-boundary years 2013-2025 are used, based on observed date endpoints rather than proof of complete reporting for every day.
